title: Quasiregular maps
summary: Linear distortion (minimal stretch; outer, inner and Hilbert–Schmidt distortion with the sharp comparisons); K-quasiregular maps between oriented Riemannian n-manifolds on the Sobolev class W^{1,n}_loc(M,N) of SobolevMapsBetweenManifolds; outer, inner, maximal and Hilbert–Schmidt distortion of maps, attainment, Jacobian sign, locality, constancy, the C¹, Lipschitz, Euclidean and Beltrami descriptions; invariance under metrics, orientations and C¹ factors; ACL^p = W^{1,p}_loc for continuous maps and the agreement with Martio–Rickman–Väisälä; quasiregularity of non-degenerate orientation-preserving simplicial maps of C¹-triangulated manifolds; quasiregular ellipticity with orientation and metric independence, transfer along local diffeomorphisms, flat manifolds and simplicial branched coverings by tori.

targets.name: LinearMap.minStretch
targets.statement: For A : V -> W linear between real inner product spaces of dimension n >= 1, the minimal stretch ℓ(A) is the n-th singular value σ_n(A) (LinearMap.singularValues at index n - 1); it equals the minimum of |Av| over unit vectors v.
hypotheses: V, W, X real inner product spaces of dimension n >= 1, each with an orientation
A : V -> W and B : W -> X linear

api.name: minStretch_mul_norm_le
api.statement: ℓ(A)|v| <= |Av| for all v, with equality for a right singular vector of σ_n; ℓ(A) is attained as the minimum over the unit sphere

api.name: minStretch_le_norm
api.statement: ℓ(A) <= ‖A‖, with equality iff A is a non-negative multiple of a linear isometry

api.name: minStretch_pos_iff
api.statement: ℓ(A) > 0 iff A is injective; then ℓ(A)·‖A⁻¹‖ = 1

api.name: minStretch_comp
api.statement: ℓ(B∘A) >= ℓ(B)ℓ(A); ℓ(cA) = |c|ℓ(A); ℓ(U∘A∘U') = ℓ(A) for linear isometric equivalences U, U'

api.name: minStretch_pow_le_normDet
api.statement: ℓ(A)^n <= normDet(A) <= ‖A‖^n, since normDet(A) = σ_1⋯σ_n

api.name: lipschitz_minStretch
api.statement: |ℓ(A) - ℓ(A')| <= ‖A - A'‖; ℓ is continuous and Borel

tests.name: minStretch_zero_projection
tests.statement: the zero map and the projection of ℝ² onto a line have ℓ = 0, the projection having ‖A‖ = 1; the minimum of |Av| over all v (not unit v) is 0 even for the identity

tests.name: minStretch_dim_one
tests.statement: n = 1: ℓ(a·id) = ‖a·id‖ = |a|

targets.name: LinearMap.outerDistortion / LinearMap.innerDistortion
targets.statement: q_O(A) ∈ [0,∞]: ‖A‖^n / J(A) if J(A) > 0, q_O(0) = 0, q_O(A) = ∞ if A ≠ 0 and J(A) <= 0. q_I(A) ∈ [0,∞): J(A)/ℓ(A)^n if J(A) > 0, 0 if J(A) <= 0. J(A) is the oriented Jacobian of SobolevMapsBetweenManifolds T4.
hypotheses: V, W, X real inner product spaces of dimension n >= 1, each with an orientation
A : V -> W and B : W -> X linear

api.name: outerDistortion_of_jacobian_pos
api.statement: if J(A) > 0: q_O(A) = Π_{i>=2} σ_1/σ_i >= 1 and q_I(A) = Π_{i<=n-1} σ_i/σ_n >= 1, both >= σ_1/σ_n

api.name: outerDistortion_invariance
api.statement: q_O, q_I unchanged by orientation-preserving linear isometric equivalences on either side and by c > 0; for c < 0, unchanged for even n, while for odd n and J(A) > 0, q_O(cA) = ∞ and q_I(cA) = 0

api.name: outerDistortion_neg_orientation
api.statement: reversing exactly one orientation negates J(A); reversing both changes neither quotient

api.name: outerDistortion_comp_le
api.statement: q_O(B∘A) <= q_O(B) q_O(A) for all A, B (0·∞ = 0); q_I(B∘A) <= q_I(B) q_I(A) when J(A) >= 0 and J(B) >= 0

api.name: outerDistortion_le_one_iff
api.statement: q_O(A) <= 1 iff A = 0 or A = λU with λ > 0 and U a linear isometry with J(U) = 1

api.name: lowerSemicontinuous_outerDistortion
api.statement: q_O is lower semicontinuous on the space of linear maps V -> W; q_O, q_I are Borel

tests.name: outerDistortion_reflection
tests.statement: diag(−1,1): q_O = ∞, q_I = 0, while the naive quotient ‖R‖²/J(R) is −1

tests.name: outerDistortion_zero

tests.name: innerDistortion_comp_counterexample

tests.name: outerDistortion_neg_id

targets.statement: For real K >= 0: ‖A‖^n <= K J(A) iff q_O(A) <= K, and J(A) <= K ℓ(A)^n iff q_I(A) <= K. If J(A) > 0 then q_I(A) <= q_O(A)^(n−1) and q_O(A) <= q_I(A)^(n−1); q_I = q_O^(n−1) iff σ_1 = … = σ_(n−1); q_O = q_I^(n−1) iff σ_2 = … = σ_n; for n = 2, q_O = q_I = σ_1/σ_2; q_O = 1 iff q_I = 1 iff A = λU.
hypotheses: V, W, X real inner product spaces of dimension n >= 1, each with an orientation
A : V -> W and B : W -> X linear
K >= 0 real (characterisation)
J(A) > 0 (comparison)

targets.name: LinearMap.planar_distortion
targets.statement: For A z = a z + b z̄ on ℂ oriented by (1, i): ‖A‖ = |a|+|b|, ℓ(A) = ||a|−|b||, J(A) = det A = |a|²−|b|²; q_O(A) = q_I(A) = (|a|+|b|)/(|a|−|b|) if |b| < |a|; q_O(A) = ∞ if A ≠ 0 and |b| >= |a|; for 0 <= k < 1, q_O(A) <= (1+k)/(1−k) iff |b| <= k|a|.

ℂ oriented by the basis (1, i)

gaps.title: The continuous Sobolev class W^{1,p}_loc(M, N)
gaps.detail: Chartwise class of continuous maps for 1 <= p <= ∞, independent of the atlases; restriction to open submanifolds; locality for open covers; independent of the metrics; C¹ maps belong for every p with Df = mfderiv f a.e.
gaps.needs: For continuous maps between Hausdorff, second countable, boundaryless manifolds and `1 ≤ p ≤ ∞`, the chartwise class `W^{1,p}_loc(M, N)`, independent of the atlases and of the metrics, closed under restriction to open submanifolds, local for open covers, and containing every `C¹` map with `Df = mfderiv f` almost everywhere.

gaps.title: The weak differential Df and null sets
gaps.detail: The a.e.-unique chart-measurable field Df(x) : T_xM -> T_f(x)N with its chart formula; chartwise TauCeti.IsNullSet null sets coincide with TauCeti.riemannianVolume null sets for every continuous metric.
gaps.needs: For `f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M, N)`, the almost-everywhere unique, chart-measurable weak differential `Df(x) : T_xM → T_{f(x)}N` with its chart formula, and the agreement of chartwise `TauCeti.IsNullSet` null sets with the null sets of `TauCeti.riemannianVolume` for every continuous metric.

gaps.title: The operator norm ‖Df‖
gaps.detail: Measurability of x ↦ ‖Df(x)‖ and, for maps with representatives in W^{1,1}_loc, membership in W^{1,p}_loc iff ‖Df‖ ∈ L^p_loc(M).
gaps.needs: For Riemannian `M` and `N`, the measurability of `x ↦ ‖Df(x)‖` and, for continuous `f` with local representatives in `W^{1,1}_loc`, the equivalence of `f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M, N)` with `‖Df‖ ∈ L^p_loc(M)`, with `‖Df‖` changed only by bounded factors under uniformly comparable metrics.

gaps.title: The oriented Jacobian of linear maps and of Sobolev maps
gaps.detail: J(A) with A^*(o_W.volumeForm) = J(A)·o_V.volumeForm; multiplicativity; sign under reversal of one orientation; |J(A)| = normDet(A); J = det for endomorphisms; Hadamard |J(A)| <= ‖A‖ⁿ; J_f = J(Df) a.e. measurable, |J_f| <= ‖Df‖ⁿ, J_f ∈ L¹_loc for p >= n.
gaps.needs: For oriented inner product spaces of one dimension `n`, the oriented Jacobian `J(A)` with `A^*(o_W.volumeForm) = J(A) · o_V.volumeForm`, multiplicative, negated by reversing one orientation, with `|J(A)| = normDet(A) ≤ ‖A‖ⁿ` and `J(A) = det A` for endomorphisms; and, for `f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M, N)` between oriented Riemannian `n`-manifolds, the measurable Jacobian `J_f = J(Df)` almost everywhere, with `|J_f| ≤ ‖Df‖ⁿ` and `J_f ∈ L¹_loc(M)` when `p ≥ n`.

gaps.title: Chain rules with C¹ factors on manifolds
gaps.detail: Precomposition with C¹ local diffeomorphisms (null preimages of null sets) and postcomposition of continuous Sobolev maps with C¹ maps, each with the a.e. chain rule and no bound on the C¹ factor.
gaps.needs: For a `C¹` local diffeomorphism `θ : M' → M`, `f ∘ θ ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M', N)` with `D(f ∘ θ)(y) = Df(θ y) ∘ dθ_y` almost everywhere and null preimages of null sets, and for a `C¹` map `g : N → P`, `g ∘ f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(M, P)` with `D(g ∘ f)(x) = dg_{f(x)} ∘ Df(x)` almost everywhere, with no bound on `dθ` or `dg`.

gaps.title: The Euclidean case of the class
gaps.detail: For Ω ⊆ E open and N = E with identity charts and flat metrics: membership iff continuity and a TauCeti.HasWeakFDerivOn derivative Du with ‖Du‖ ∈ L^p_loc; Df = Du and J_f = det Du a.e. for one orientation on both sides.
gaps.needs: For an open `Ω` of an `n`-dimensional real inner product space `E` with identity charts and flat metrics, `f ∈ W^{1,p}_loc(Ω, E)` if and only if `f` is continuous on `Ω` with a `TauCeti.HasWeakFDerivOn` derivative `Du` such that `‖Du‖ ∈ L^p_loc(Ω)`, and then `Df = Du` almost everywhere and, for one orientation on both sides, `J_f = det Du` almost everywhere.

gaps.title: Descent of orientations to orbit spaces
gaps.detail: For a group acting freely, properly discontinuously by smooth orientation-preserving diffeomorphisms on an oriented connected manifold X, X/Γ has a unique orientation for which the orbit projection is orientation preserving at every point. DifferentialGeometry Layer 2 plans pullback orientations and the orientation double cover, not this descent; proposed for DifferentialGeometry, Part II.
gaps.needs: For a group `Γ` acting freely, properly discontinuously and by smooth orientation-preserving diffeomorphisms on an oriented manifold `X`, the unique orientation of the orbit space `X/Γ` for which the orbit projection is orientation preserving at every point.
